plugins.name: chime
plugins.description: Plays a macOS system sound when a session finishes a turn or needs input.

plugins.name: tabcolor
plugins.description: Colors the tmux window / iTerm2 tab by Claude Code session state.

plugins.name: spinner
plugins.description: Warframe fork of hoobnn's spinner mod: pixel scenes, a mascot beside the spinner and a companion pet in six Warframe themes.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: OneWave's swarm mod: /swarm opens a live map of subagents and agent teams, who spawned whom, what each is doing, who is talking.

plugins.name: session-wrapped
plugins.description: OneWave's session-wrapped mod: /wrapped plays a Spotify-Wrapped-style session recap and saves a PNG card to ~/Desktop.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Fork of hellosverre's skins mod: themed transcript rows, cards and spinner, keeping your settings.json spinnerVerbs.

plugins.name: antigravity-agents
plugins.description: Fork of markfulton's antigravity-agents skill: Claude delegates reviews, audits and refactors to Google Antigravity CLI (agy) sub-agents in the background, then verifies what comes back.
